contentTypes.intro: A replay is recorded when you enter a checked content type.
autoLock.intro: How many replays to keep for each content. 0 keeps none. A blank field uses the count from the level above. Cleared replays are kept before newer ones.
autoDelete.intro: Unkept replays move to Deleted after the recording date. Deleted recordings are removed once the folder passes the size limit.
autoDelete.days.info: 0 disables. Kept replays stay. Others move to Deleted this many days after recording.
autoDelete.size.info: 0 disables. Past this size, the oldest recordings in Deleted are removed.
card.convert.nomap: This replay build cannot be converted.
card.anonymize.current: Only the current patch can be anonymized.
dialog.delete.title: Delete replay
dialog.convert.title: Convert replay
dialog.convert.duplicate: The same replay is already in the library. The file outside the library will be deleted, and the library file will be converted.
dialog.convert.outside: This replay is outside the library. The original file will be moved into the library, then converted.
dialog.anonymize.title: Anonymize replay
dialog.anonymize.duplicate: The same replay is already in the library. The file outside the library will be deleted, and the library file will be anonymized.
dialog.anonymize.outside: This replay is outside the library. The original file will be moved into the library, then anonymized.
camera.collision: Collision is disabled while the lock is on.
camera.cammy: Cammy is loaded. Do not use FreeCam with camera lock.
camera.wasd.hint: Stops WASD from moving the locked camera during replay. Walking in the field is unchanged.
overlay.title: Characters
overlay.enable.hint: Applies the choices below. Off keeps them but does not apply them.
overlay.pets.hint: Player-owned pets and chocobo companions. Not minions.
overlay.npc.hint: Town NPCs and NPC party members such as Trust. Not minions.
overlay.enemy.hint: Hostile and guard Battle NPCs, including weak spots.
overlay.label: Player label
